name: AS3046
full_name: NPN Transistor Array (5-transistor monolithic array, one matched differential pair + 3 isolated)
description: Five general-purpose silicon NPN transistors on a common monolithic substrate: Q1/Q2 are internally wired as a differentially-connected pair (common emitter, VBE matched to <=1mV typ), and Q3/Q4/Q5 are isolated general-purpose transistors sharing only the substrate. Alfa RPAR's clone of the classic RCA CA3046 / Fairchild-TI LM3046 monolithic NPN transistor array, same pinout and functional layout. Used wherever on-chip thermal/electrical matching beats discrete transistors: differential amps, current mirrors, temperature-compensated stages, and filters -- common in analog synth and instrumentation circuits that specifically call out a 3046-family array.

pins.name: E1,2
pins.description: common emitter of Q1 and Q2 (differential pair tail); not independently accessible per-transistor

pins.name: E5 / SUBSTRATE
pins.description: emitter of Q5, doubling as the die substrate connection; each transistor's collector is isolated from the substrate by an internal diode, so this pin MUST be tied to the most negative point in the external circuit to keep the isolation diodes reverse-biased and preserve normal transistor action

PDIP-14.notes: per Alfa AS3046 datasheet (2019 v.2), Connection Diagram + Pin Information table, top view, 14-pin PDIP 300mil/2.54mm pitch. Same pin numbering and functional layout is shared with the SOIC-14 package (single connection diagram covers both in the datasheet).

pins.description: common emitter of Q1 and Q2 (differential pair tail); not independently accessible per-transistor

pins.name: E5 / SUBSTRATE
pins.description: emitter of Q5, doubling as the die substrate connection; each transistor's collector is isolated from the substrate by an internal diode, so this pin MUST be tied to the most negative point in the external circuit to keep the isolation diodes reverse-biased and preserve normal transistor action

SOIC-14.notes: per Alfa AS3046 datasheet (2019 v.2), Connection Diagram + Pin Information table, top view, 14-pin SOIC 150mil/1.27mm pitch (device marked AS3046D). Same pin numbering and functional layout as the PDIP-14 package.

extra.Vcio (collector-substrate): 50V (each transistor); each collector is isolated from substrate by an internal diode
extra.Rth(JA) PDIP-14: 180 C/W (typ, on eval PCB in free air)
extra.Rth(JA) SOIC-14: 220 C/W (typ, on eval PCB in free air)
extra.operating temp: not stated separately from Tj=25C test condition on this datasheet

typical_application: Matched differential amplifier front ends, current mirrors, temperature-compensated bias/amplifier stages, and active filters that specifically call for a 3046-family monolithic NPN array instead of discrete transistors -- the on-chip thermal/electrical matching between Q1/Q2 is the whole point.
gotchas: pin 13 is both Q5's emitter AND the die substrate; it must be tied to the most negative point in the circuit or the internal collector-substrate isolation diodes stop doing their job and transistors misbehave/cross-couple
Q1/Q2 share a single emitter pin (3) as a wired differential pair; you cannot use them as two independent transistors

Q3, Q4, Q5 are isolated from each other and from Q1/Q2 but are NOT tightly matched to the same spec as the Q1/Q2 pair -- offset voltage between them is only guaranteed to 1.5mV max vs 1mV max for the dedicated pair
low absolute ratings: 30mA/200mW per transistor, 500mW total package -- small-signal use only, not a power device
pin-compatible clone of the classic RCA CA3046 / Fairchild-TI LM3046 array; datasheet gives no max hFE, only mins, and no explicit ft or noise spec
